newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1 AUDIENCE SHARE DROPS IN JULY - FRENCH MEDIAMAT.
newsitem.headline: TF1 AUDIENCE SHARE DROPS IN JULY - FRENCH MEDIAMAT.

text.p: The audience share of French private television station TF1 slumped in July compared to June, measurement institute Mediametrie reported.
Mediametrie, in monthly figures published on Tuesday, said public television channels France 2 and France 3 posted a strong rise in their audience in July from June.
Compared with July 1996, France 2 and TF1 both lost audience share, while France 3 gained audience, the figures showed.

NOTE: The results in brackets take into account the fact that M6, Arte and La Cinquieme do not cover the whole French population. M6 covers 91 percent of the population, while Arte and and La Cinquieme cover 88 percent. They also take into account the fact that Arte broadcasts during the evening only, while La Cinquieme is available only during the day on terrestrial television. Certain cable services broadcast La Cinquieme during the evening.
